items.detail: Defeated Michaela Dostalova by TKO (punches) at 4:28 of round one in the 2019 OKTAGON 4 Challenge qualification. Tapology counts this among Szabová's 12 professional wins; UFC and Sherdog do not.

items.label: WIN · Paula Marcisova · exhibition MMA
items.detail: Submitted Paula Marcisova at 0:12 of round one at OKTAGON Underground 4 under modified rules prohibiting ground strikes. Tapology classifies this as an exhibition MMA bout; it is not part of her professional MMA record.
items.sourceLabel: Tapology fight history (sport and ruleset noted)

items.label: WIN · Lucia Krajčovič · exhibition MMA
items.detail: Won a unanimous decision over Lucia Krajčovič at OKTAGON Underground 6. Tapology classifies this as exhibition MMA with modified rules, not as a professional MMA victory.

items.label: LOSS · Tereza Bledá · exhibition MMA
items.detail: Lost a split decision to Tereza Bledá at OKTAGON Underground 7 Super Final. Tapology lists the fight as exhibition MMA, so this is not a loss in her undefeated professional MMA record.
items.sourceLabel: Tapology fight history (sport and ruleset noted)

items.label: WIN · Anzelika Petkevičiūtė · first bout in UFC/Sherdog professional record
items.detail: Submitted Anželika Petkevičiūtė by armbar at 0:43 of round one at OKTAGON 18. This is the first bout in the UFC/Sherdog 10-0 professional tally; Tapology also counts the two earlier OKTAGON Challenge qualifiers.

items.label: WIN · Rizlen Zouak
items.detail: Submitted Zouak with an armbar at 1:25 of round two.

items.label: WIN · Christina Netza
items.detail: Knocked out Netza with a head kick at 1:30 of round one.

items.label: WIN · Cornelia Holm
items.detail: Won a unanimous decision at OKTAGON 26.

items.label: Long gap in recorded professional MMA bouts
items.detail: The Sherdog professional MMA list shows no recorded bouts between July 24, 2021 and March 23, 2024. This is a records gap, not evidence of a specific injury or personal hiatus.

items.label: LOSS · Michaela Hlaváčiková · Muay Thai
items.detail: Lost a split decision to Michaela Hlaváčiková at MTO Fight Night. This was a Muay Thai bout, not professional MMA.

items.label: WIN · Alexandra Andersrod · modified-rules Muay Thai
items.detail: Defeated Alexandra Andersrod by unanimous decision in a modified-rules Muay Thai bout at OKTAGON 47. This result does not count toward her professional MMA record.

items.label: WIN · Marcela Šafránová · Muay Thai
items.detail: Won a unanimous decision against Marcela Šafránová at Hanuman Cup 46. Tapology classifies the result as Muay Thai, not MMA.

items.label: WIN · Roza Gumienna
items.detail: Submitted Gumienna by armbar at 4:38 of round three at OKTAGON 55.

items.label: WIN · Aitana Álvarez
items.detail: Won a unanimous decision at OKTAGON 59.

items.label: WIN · Kalindra Faria
items.detail: Submitted Faria by keylock at 4:16 of round one at OKTAGON 67.

items.label: WIN · Cecilie Maria Bolander · OKTAGON bantamweight title
items.detail: Stopped Bolander by ground strikes at 3:11 of round one at OKTAGON 74, becoming the promotion's women's bantamweight champion.

items.label: WIN · Leidiane Fernandes · OKTAGON flyweight title
items.detail: Stopped Fernandes with elbows and punches at 2:12 of round three at OKTAGON 87, adding the vacant flyweight title to her bantamweight championship and becoming a two-division OKTAGON titleholder.

items.label: WIN · Lucie Pudilová · five-round main event
items.detail: Defeated former UFC fighter Lucie Pudilová by unanimous decision over five rounds at OKTAGON 92 in a bantamweight championship defense. OKTAGON reports a 12-0 overall record, while Sherdog documents 10 professional MMA bouts; the difference is a source-count discrepancy, not two omitted named results.

items.label: Scheduled UFC debut vs. Tainara Lisboa
items.detail: Scheduled UFC flyweight debut against Tainara Lisboa on October 31, 2026. Tapology counts a 12-0 professional record (4 knockouts, 5 submissions, 3 decisions), including two 2019 OKTAGON Challenge qualifiers. UFC and Sherdog classify those two bouts differently and list 10-0 (3 knockouts, 4 submissions, 3 decisions).

items.label: Starts Muay Thai training
items.detail: Lisboa says she joined Muay Thai classes as a teenager, initially for weight and anxiety management, and later became a competitive striker.

items.label: Two Muay Thai world championships
items.detail: Competed for years in Thailand and won two Muay Thai world championships before transitioning to MMA.
